title: Verified client logs in and restores the session
description: Verify that a verified client can sign in and later restore the authenticated session.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/v1/auth/login
Fill in the email field with a verified client email
Fill in the password field with the verified client password
Submit the login form
Open the session view
Verify the authenticated user session is restored
Verify the signed-in user profile is visible

title: Authenticated user logs out and loses the session
description: Verify that a signed-in user can log out and is no longer authenticated afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/v1/auth/login
Fill in the email field with a verified client email
Fill in the password field with the verified client password
Submit the login form
Submit the logout action
Open the session view
Verify the user is no longer authenticated
Verify the session is not available after logout

title: Visitor registers for a new account
description: Verify that a visitor can create a new client account and receive a verification message.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/v1/auth/register
Fill in the full name field with a unique test name
Fill in the email field with a unique test email
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Accept the consent checkbox
Submit the registration form
Verify a registration success confirmation is visible
Verify an email verification message is visible

title: Visitor verifies account with a valid code
description: Verify that a visitor can confirm a newly registered account using a valid six-digit verification code.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/v1/auth/register
Fill in the full name field with a unique test name
Fill in the email field with a unique test email
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Accept the consent checkbox
Submit the registration form
Open the email verification form for the new account
Fill in the email field with the registered email
Fill in the verification code field with a valid six-digit code
Submit the verification form
Verify the account is marked as verified
Verify a verified user confirmation is visible

title: Client resets password and can use the new password
description: Verify that a client can request a password reset, set a new password, and access the account with the updated credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/v1/auth/forgot-password
Fill in the email field with the client email
Submit the password reset request
Open the password reset form for the client account
Fill in the email field with the client email
Fill in the reset code field with a valid six-digit code
Fill in the new password field with a valid new password
Submit the password reset form
Verify the password reset completes successfully
Verify the updated credentials can be used to sign in

title: Verified client creates an enrollment order
description: Verify that a verified client can submit a new enrollment order and see the created order reference and history.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/v1/auth/login
Fill in the email field with a verified client email
Fill in the password field with the verified client password
Submit the login form
Open the order creation form
Fill in the full name field with the client name
Fill in the phone number field with a valid phone number
Select a specialization
Submit the order form
Verify a new order is created
Verify an order reference and history are displayed

title: Admin can update an order status and add a private note

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the admin email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/orders
Open an order from the list
Change the order status to a valid next state
Add an internal note to the order
Verify the new status is reflected in the order history
Verify the internal note is displayed in the admin view

title: Admin can view order metrics
